
		<h1 class="postTitle">
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/linyihai/p/19111865" title="发布于 2025-09-25 19:39">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Rust/C/C++ 混合构建 - Cmake集成Cargo编译动态库</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>Cmake是一个强大的多语言编译工具，其内置模块提供了强大的扩展能力。</p>
<p>Rust官方的构建工具是Cargo，其提供了依赖下载，上传和编译等多项功能，极大的便利了Rust项目的开发。</p>
<p>目前C++多数用Cmake构建，如果是Rust集成cmake构建c++动态库，可以用Cargo构建脚本集成cmake-rs构建。</p>
<p>如果要调用Cargo构建Rust编译的动态库，并且通过cmake作为构建工具统一调度，目前主流方案是使用Cmake内置的add_custom_target模块调用Cargo构建。</p>
<h2 id="playground">Playground</h2>
<p>1、cargo new rust-lib —lib 创建rust 项目，并在Cargo.toml中指定类型为cdylib</p>
<pre><code class="language-toml">[package]
name = "rust_lib"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib"]
</code></pre>
<p>2、在 src/lib.rs 创建greet_from_rust动态库函数</p>
<pre><code class="language-rust">#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn greet_from_rust() {
    println!("Hello, greeting!")
}
</code></pre>
<p>3、创建call_rust.c，内容如下</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">extern void greet_from_rust();

int main(void) {
    greet_from_rust();
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<p>4、编写Cmake构建规则，创建CMakeLists.txt, 其内容如下</p>
<pre><code>cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(call_rust)

set(ARGS --target-dir ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/target)

if (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Release")
    message(STATUS "[RUST] Detected release build")
    set(build_profile "release")
    set(ARGS ${ARGS} --release)
else()
    message(STATUS "[RUST] Using default debug build")
    set(build_profile "debug")
endif()

add_custom_target(
    cargo_build ALL
    COMMAND 
        ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env 
        cargo build ${ARGS}
    DEPENDS src/lib.rs
)

add_executable(call_rust call_rust.c)
add_library(rust_lib SHARED IMPORTED)
set_property(TARGET rust_lib PROPERTY IMPORTED_LOCATION "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/target/${build_profile}/librust_lib.so")
target_link_libraries(call_rust PUBLIC rust_lib)总结
</code></pre>
<p><code>add_custom_target</code>调用Cargo将<code>src/lib.rs</code> 编译成动态库，为了方便将Cargo的构建目录指定在当前项目下。</p>
<p><code>add_library</code>和<code>set_property</code> 将生成的动态库绑定到rust_lib 这个target上，最后将动态库rust_lib通过</p>
<p><code>target_link_libraries</code> 链接到call_rust二进制target上</p>
<p>Cmake构建配置完成，我们可以通过</p>
<p><code>cmake  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE:STRING=Release . </code>和<code>cmake  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE:STRING=Debug .</code></p>
<p>这两个命令切换构建选项，这也对应了Cargo构建的—release选项，然后通过</p>
<p><code>cmake —build .</code> 构建当前项目, 输出</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ cmake  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE:STRING=Release . &amp;&amp; cmake --build . &amp;&amp; ./call_rust
-- [RUST] Detected release build
-- Configuring done
-- Generating done
-- Build files have been written to: /root/workspace/build-tool-examples/rust_lib
Compiling rust_lib v0.1.0 (/root/workspace/build-tool-examples/rust_lib)
Finished release profile [optimized] target(s) in 0.44s
[  0%] Built target cargo_build
Consolidate compiler generated dependencies of target call_rust
[ 50%] Linking C executable call_rust
[100%] Built target call_rust
Hello, greeting!
</code></pre>

</div>
